_doc: Colour is assigned PROLEPTICALLY: Liu Bei carries Shu blue from chapter 1, twenty
years before there is a Shu, and Cao Cao carries Wei red while he is still a
colonel under He Jin. That keeps a character's colour fixed across all 120 chapters
at the cost of mild foreshadowing. Warlords who never found a kingdom get hues of
their own rather than borrowing one.
Hues are OKLCH so that the per-character shade ramp in tools/build_data.py varies
lightness without the muddy dark spots you get ramping in HSL. `chroma` is the
faction's base saturation: the three kingdoms sit high, the transient warlords sit
lower so the map reads as three powers among noise rather than twenty equals.
`rank` orders the legend and decides paint order where territories overlap.

han.name: Han court
han.note: Deliberately the palest thing on the map -- near-neutral, so the warlords read as colour against it. The imperial government as an independent actor: whoever holds the Emperor. Shrinks to nothing after Cao Cao takes him to Xuchang in ch. 14.

shu.name: Shu Han
shu.note: Liu Bei's following, from two men in a Zhuo county garden to the western empire.

wei.name: Cao Wei
wei.note: Cao Cao's power, later the Wei dynasty.

wu.name: Eastern Wu
wu.note: The Sun family's south-east, from Sun Jian through Sun Ce to Sun Quan.

yellowturban.name: Yellow Turbans
yellowturban.note: Zhang Jue's rising. Territory here means districts in revolt, not administration.

lijueguosi.name: Li Jue and Guo Si
lijueguosi.note: Dong Zhuo's officers, who inherit Chang'an and the Emperor after ch. 9.

taoqian.name: Tao Qian
taoqian.note: Xuzhou, willed to Liu Bei in ch. 12.

liubiao.name: Liu Biao
liubiao.note: Jing province, the buffer Liu Bei shelters in for seven years.

liuzhang.name: Liu Zhang
liuzhang.note: Yi province, inherited from his father Liu Yan. Absorbed by Liu Bei in ch. 65.

xiliang.name: Ma Teng and Han Sui
xiliang.note: The Liang province horsemen of the north-west.

zhanglu.name: Zhang Lu
zhanglu.note: The Five Pecks of Rice theocracy in Hanzhong.

nanman.name: Nanman
nanman.note: Meng Huo's southern tribes, campaigned against in ch. 87-90.

unaligned.name: Unaligned
unaligned.note: Fallback for figures with no standing allegiance.
